projects.title: MCP Slim
projects.description: Zero-dependency MCP stdio proxy and 15-tool server with capability-scoped multi-upstream session policy engine (MS019), recursive prompt and RFC 6570 resource template exfiltration shield (MS020), BM25+ intent catalog pruner (MS017), JSON-RPC response firewall (MS018), and 20 SARIF v2.1.0 security rules.
lines: BM25+ catalog pruner, JSON-RPC firewall & 20 SARIF rules.

projects.title: LoRASpectra

lines: Knots joint-SVD, isotropic flattening & TSV Procrustes (LS043-LS046).
LoRA-GA initializer, TIES/DARE ledger & QR-Core SVD for .safetensors.

projects.title: OmniVM
projects.description: Scale-to-zero Linux microVM orchestrator and MCP server on Cloud Hypervisor and KVM with unprivileged VMM chroot/namespace jails, daemonless survival leases, sparse memory hibernation, shared Virtio-FS/PMEM DAX rootfs pools, egress CIDR/DNS firewall, and token-bucket I/O QoS.
lines: Unprivileged VMM jails, survival leases & sparse hibernation.
Virtio-FS/PMEM DAX pool, egress firewall & I/O QoS governor.

projects.title: SLClean
projects.description: Windows disk and AI/developer cache utility with age-weighted orphaned Python/Node/Rust environment reclaimer (--scan-envs, SLC006-SLC008), duplicate AI weight blob scanning (--scan-dupes), composite GitHub Action, CI disk-budget gates, and WSL2/Docker .vhdx lock protection.
lines: Orphaned env reclaimer (--scan-envs) & AI blob dupes.
SLC001-SLC008 SARIF v2.1.0 & composite GitHub Action.

projects.title: SLTerm

lines: Shell & agent command firewall (SLT011-SLT016) & SSH auditor.
Output secret redactor, paste guards & Tauri 2 workspace.

projects.title: Foliora

lines: Hybrid RRF retrieval, SARIF v2.1.0 audit & Ed25519 signing.
